info.title: Chunkify analytics collector API
info.description: Self-hosted analytics collector with isolated projects in one installation. This contract describes implemented /v1 endpoints, including explicitly experimental ingestion/reader modes. Projects and named credentials are administered through the CLI. Hosted accounts, membership, project administration HTTP APIs and MCP are future work. Ingest keys and private read tokens each resolve to exactly one project; request fields cannot change that scope. Browser ingestion uses a write-only ingest key; keep read tokens on the dashboard backend. Deploy HTTPS at the ingress; loopback HTTP is for local development. JSON examples contain invented IDs and no credentials.

servers.description: Default local development address. Replace with your HTTPS collector origin.

get.description: Unauthenticated database/worker health check. Does not expose keys or queue contents.

get.summary: Inspect ingestion mode and pending queue
get.description: Private operational status. Pending counts, bytes and age are limited to the read token’s project; mode and failure state describe the shared queue. Default direct mode has no queue object. Experimental durable_queue mode includes duplicates not yet applied to DuckDB. Reads expose committed DuckDB data; successful queued ingestion can precede visibility. Separate-reader mode changes scheduling only.

401.description: Missing or invalid private read bearer token.

get.description: Limited to the project resolved from the read token. Returns full canonical payloads in ascending server ingestion order, with receipt time and optional context. All filters combine using AND; time filters use event occurred_at, not receipt time. Unknown query parameters are rejected. Private reads have no cross-origin browser access headers.

200.description: Event page; next_cursor is null at the end.

400.description: Invalid filters, bounds or cursor. Semantic validation returns JSON; malformed query syntax, unknown parameters, duplicate parameters or an invalid integer return the framework plain-text error.

401.description: Missing or invalid private read bearer token.

post.description: All records belong to the project resolved from the ingest key. Deduplication is by (project_id, event_id), including across multiple keys for one project. Client-provided project or key IDs cannot override this scope. Project and installation rate/queue limits apply. Requires application/json; native gzip is unsupported. Default maximum body is 65536 bytes, configurable with COLLECTOR_MAX_BODY_BYTES. Extra fields are preserved. Direct mode acknowledges after the DuckDB transaction commits. Repeated valid event_id values preserve the first payload and context and count once. In experimental durable queue mode, 202 means the SQLite queue entry is committed durably; DuckDB visibility and deduplication happen asynchronously. Queue mode returns 202 even for duplicates. COLLECTOR_EXPERIMENTAL_READ_WORKER changes read scheduling without changing acknowledgment guarantees.

options.description: Requires an explicitly allowed Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method: POST. No ingest key is required on preflight. post.description: All records belong to the project resolved from the ingest key. Deduplication is by (project_id, event_id), including across multiple keys for one project. Client-provided project or key IDs cannot override this scope. Project and installation rate/queue limits apply. Supports JSON logs, including multiple resources/scopes and gzip. Protobuf, gRPC, metrics and traces are outside this API. Log attributes must normalize to one of the seven AnalyticsEvent variants. Omitted nullable SDK attributes are restored to null; required identity and measurements remain mandatory. Original resource/scope/log data are preserved. The entire valid batch is committed atomically. Duplicates across native and OTLP delivery count once and preserve first delivery. Default direct mode returns 200 after DuckDB commit. Experimental durable queue mode returns the same OTLP 200 response after durable queue commit, before asynchronous DuckDB visibility; inspect /v1/ingestion to determine mode. The response never reports partial success.

get.summary: Read totals for a view cohort
get.description: Limited to the project resolved from the read token. Counts distinct view_id values with a retained view_started event. Each view is attributed to its earliest retained start ordered by sequence, occurred_at, then ingestion order. All filters select these starts. Playing time uses a matching video_id/viewer_id view_ended event if present, otherwise the latest retained view_snapshot, ordered by sequence, occurrence time, then ingestion order; missing values contribute zero. Whole cumulative playtime is attributed to the selected start, including events after the time window or with later browser context. Snapshots are never added together. unique_viewers counts distinct non-null supplied viewer_id values, not verified people. Views without a retained start do not contribute. Retention/deletion remove contributions. view_ended does not imply completion; lost final browser delivery can undercount playtime. Unknown query parameters, event_name, cursor and limit are rejected.

400.description: Invalid filters, bounds or cursor. Semantic validation returns JSON; malformed query syntax, unknown parameters, duplicate parameters or an invalid integer return the framework plain-text error.

401.description: Missing or invalid private read bearer token.

get.description: Limited to the project resolved from the read token. Counts distinct view_id values with a retained view_started event. Each view is attributed to its earliest retained start ordered by sequence, occurred_at, then ingestion order. All filters select these starts. Playing time uses a matching video_id/viewer_id view_ended event if present, otherwise the latest retained view_snapshot, ordered by sequence, occurrence time, then ingestion order; missing values contribute zero. Whole cumulative playtime is attributed to the selected start, including events after the time window or with later browser context. Snapshots are never added together. unique_viewers counts distinct non-null supplied viewer_id values, not verified people. Views without a retained start do not contribute. Retention/deletion remove contributions. view_ended does not imply completion; lost final browser delivery can undercount playtime. Rows are ordered by video_id ascending. unique_viewers is per video and must not be summed to obtain portfolio unique viewers. Unknown query parameters and event_name are rejected.

200.description: Video page; next_cursor is null at the end.

get.summary: Read hourly or daily metrics by view start
get.description: Limited to the project resolved from the read token. Requires from, to and interval=hour|day. Returns all UTC calendar buckets intersecting [from, to), ordered oldest first, with zero metrics for empty buckets. At most 1000 buckets including partial boundary buckets; larger ranges return 400, never truncated data. Dates are normalized to milliseconds, as with the other read endpoints. Counts distinct view_id values with a retained view_started event. The first retained start, ordered by SDK sequence, occurrence time and ingestion order, determines all filters and the bucket. Playing time uses the final matching video_id/viewer_id view_ended value, otherwise the latest view_snapshot; missing values contribute zero. Whole cumulative playing time belongs to the start bucket, even if playback continued after it or after to. This is playing time for views started in each bucket, not time actually played during that interval and not concurrent viewers. Snapshots are never added together. Views and playing time across buckets equal getSummary with identical filters on the same retained data. unique_viewers counts distinct non-null supplied viewer_id values per bucket and cannot be summed for global unique viewers. Views without a retained start do not contribute. Missing final events can undercount playing time. Retention/deletion remove contributions. The entire response uses one ingestion watermark; later requests may change with new events. Unknown query parameters, event_name, limit, cursor and project overrides are rejected.

200.description: Complete UTC start-cohort series, including empty buckets.

400.description: Invalid filters, bounds or cursor. Semantic validation returns JSON; malformed query syntax, unknown parameters, duplicate parameters or an invalid integer return the framework plain-text error.

401.description: Missing or invalid private read bearer token.

get.summary: Read playback quality for a view cohort
get.description: Limited to the project resolved from the read token. All filters select the earliest retained view_started by sequence, occurrence time, then ingestion order, as in summary. Each view is one playback attempt, including failures before playback. Matching video_id/viewer_id measurements come from the final view_ended when present, otherwise the latest view_snapshot; event precedence is followed by sequence, occurrence time and ingestion order. All fields come from that one event, including nulls. Later events outside the start-date window still contribute. startup_time_ms reports non-null sample count and continuous, linearly interpolated median/p95. Zero is valid; no measurements returns null percentiles. Buffering uses only views with both durations available and positive combined duration; ratio is SUM(rebuffer_duration_ms) / (SUM(playing_time_ms) + SUM(rebuffer_duration_ms)), not the average of per-view ratios. Its totals cover only those samples; no samples returns zero totals and null ratio. Fatal errors count distinct selected views with any retained matching playback_error where error_fatal=true; ratio divides by all selected attempts. No views returns null, while no observed fatal error among selected views returns zero. Error metrics describe observed delivery, not guaranteed error-free playback. Missing final events can leave partial values. Start-only views have no measurement samples. Orphans are excluded; retention/deletion remove contributions. Ratios are fractions from 0 to 1. Unknown parameters, event_name, cursor and limit are rejected.

200.description: Playback-quality metrics and sample counts for selected starts.

400.description: Invalid filters, bounds or cursor. Semantic validation returns JSON; malformed query syntax, unknown parameters, duplicate parameters or an invalid integer return the framework plain-text error.

500.description: Storage operation failed or a numeric aggregate exceeded the finite response range.

ingestKey.name: X-Chunkify-Ingest-Key
ingestKey.description: Public write-only opaque key associated with exactly one project by collector CLI administration. The collector looks up its hash to resolve project_id and ingest_key_id; the project ID is not encoded in the token. Does not authorize reads or authenticate a viewer. Never send credentials in query parameters.

readToken.description: Private opaque read token associated with exactly one project. All reads are limited to that project, regardless of request fields or cursors. This is not a JWT. Keep it on your dashboard backend; the exact Authorization prefix is Bearer.

from.name: from
from.description: Inclusive RFC3339 occurrence-time lower bound, with timezone. Summary/video queries apply it to the selected view_started event. Must be before to.

to.name: to
to.description: Exclusive RFC3339 occurrence-time upper bound, with timezone. Summary/video queries apply it to the selected view_started event.

video_id.name: video_id
video_id.description: Exact video ID. Combined with all other filters using AND.

viewer_id.name: viewer_id
viewer_id.description: Exact supplied viewer ID. Missing/null viewer IDs do not match.

event_name.name: event_name
event_name.description: Raw-event queries only. Summaries and videos reject this parameter.

browser_name.name: browser_name
browser_name.description: Exact case-sensitive browser name in event_context, for example Chrome. No trimming/coercion. Unknown names are valid and match no records. Missing/null values do not match. Summary/video queries use the selected view_started event.

os_name.name: os_name
os_name.description: Exact case-sensitive OS name in event_context, for example macOS. No trimming/coercion. Unknown names are valid and match no records. Missing/null values do not match. Summary/video queries use the selected view_started event.

device_type.name: device_type
device_type.description: Exact event_context device class. unknown matches only an explicit unknown value, not missing/null fields. Summary/video queries use the selected view_started event.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum rows on this page. Only events and videos support pagination.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the same project, endpoint and exact filters. Keep all filters on each page. Page size may change. Each cursor pins the first page ingest watermark so later inserts are excluded; retention or deletion can remove records between pages. A cursor is not a durable database snapshot or authorization token.

origin.name: Origin
origin.description: Optional browser origin. When supplied it must exactly match COLLECTOR_ALLOWED_ORIGINS. Origin-less server requests are allowed with the ingest key.

identity_encoding.name: Content-Encoding
identity_encoding.description: Native JSON accepts an absent header or identity. gzip is supported only on /v1/logs.

otlp_encoding.name: Content-Encoding
otlp_encoding.description: Optional gzip. Both compressed and decompressed body sizes are bounded by COLLECTOR_MAX_BODY_BYTES, default 65536 bytes.

timeseries_from.name: from
timeseries_from.description: Required inclusive RFC3339 bound with timezone, applied to the selected view start. Must have from < to after millisecond normalization. Together with interval, the range may intersect at most 1000 UTC buckets. Boundaries may be partial buckets.

timeseries_to.name: to
timeseries_to.description: Required exclusive RFC3339 bound with timezone, applied to the selected view start. Must have from < to after millisecond normalization. Together with interval, the range may intersect at most 1000 UTC buckets. Boundaries may be partial buckets.

interval.name: interval
interval.description: UTC calendar bucket size. hour aligns to the UTC hour; day aligns to midnight UTC. At most 1000 buckets, including empty and partial boundary buckets. No pagination or automatic coarsening.

AnalyticsEvent.description: One of the seven schema_version 1 SDK events. Native JSON must include required nullable fields as null. Extra properties are preserved. Millisecond measurements are cumulative for a view unless the field names an individual state or seek interval. Counts and dimensions accept non-negative JSON numbers as the current collector does.

browser_context.description: Optional caller-supplied context. The Chunkify adapter emits the BrowserContext schema. The collector preserves this raw property without validating its shape. It copies supported primitive fields from schema_version 1 objects into event_context; do not treat caller-supplied metadata as authenticated.

BrowserContext.description: Shape emitted by createChunkifyAdapter in a browser. Measurements unavailable through browser APIs are null. Stable context is cached per adapter; viewport, screen, pixel ratio and UTC-minus-local timezone offset are read per send. The adapter does not supply client IP or viewer identity.

user_agent.description: Copied from browser_context.user_agent when primitive. See BrowserContext for the SDK type; the collector currently accepts any primitive here.

peer_ip.description: Direct TCP peer IP, canonical IPv4 or IPv6.

client_ip.description: Request sender IP. Direct peer unless it is an explicitly trusted proxy. Null when a trusted proxy has no usable forwarding chain. A gateway sender may not be the viewer.

EventContext.description: Flat derived context. Browser fields are optional and may be null. Server IP fields are present only when IP storage is enabled, which is the default. Trusted proxies use the rightmost untrusted X-Forwarded-For hop. Request-derived fields cannot be overridden by event properties. Omitted when no context is available.

project_id.description: Trusted project identifier resolved from the ingest key. Historical events migrate to default.

ingest_key_id.description: Safe stable identifier of the first accepted ingest key. Null for events received before project metadata was recorded. Never contains the key secret.

OtlpError.description: OTLP JSON google.rpc.Status subset emitted by this collector. The optional code and details fields are omitted; use the HTTP status for classification.

OtlpSuccess.description: ExportLogsServiceResponse with no partialSuccess. Entire batch succeeded or the whole request returned an error.

QueueStatus.description: Queue totals before DuckDB deduplication. pending_bytes counts serialized pending payload bytes, not the total SQLite file or filesystem allocation. Zero pending requests means the queue is drained at the instant sampled; failed reports a worker failure.

intValue.description: Signed int64. Strings avoid JavaScript precision loss.

bytesValue.description: Only an explicit null is accepted; non-null bytesValue attributes are unsupported.

OtlpAttributeValue.description: Supported typed log attribute values. An absent, empty, or all-null typed value decodes to null. At most one known typed field may be non-null. Non-null bytesValue attributes are unsupported. Unknown properties are ignored while the original record is preserved. Nested arrays and key/value lists are supported; absent/null values arrays decode as empty.

OtlpAttribute.description: An absent or null key decodes to the empty string; duplicate decoded keys reject the request. An absent value decodes to null.

OtlpAnyValue.description: Standard OTLP AnyValue in a preserved resource, scope or body. This collector does not decode these fields into the event.

intValue.description: Signed int64. Strings avoid JavaScript precision loss.

OtlpLogRecord.description: Event fields must be in attributes using the exact native field names. eventName, timestamps, resource and scope do not supply missing event fields. Required nullable native fields omitted by the SDK are restored to null. Duplicate attribute keys and unsupported attribute values fail the entire request.

OtlpExportRequest.description: OTLP/HTTP JSON logs only. An empty request is valid. Default maximum 100 log records across all resources/scopes, configurable with COLLECTOR_MAX_OTLP_RECORDS. Every log must normalize to AnalyticsEvent; JSON Schema alone cannot express this cross-format validation.

StoredOtlpContext.description: Present only when the first accepted delivery of event_id used OTLP. Later duplicates do not replace original data or add transport context.

bucket_start.description: UTC interval start in RFC3339 with milliseconds and Z. May precede from in a partial first bucket; only starts inside [from, to) contribute.

from.description: Inclusive query bound normalized to UTC milliseconds.

to.description: Exclusive query bound normalized to UTC milliseconds.

views.description: Selected playback attempts with a retained start, including failed attempts.

sample_views.description: Views with a non-null startup measurement on the selected final event or latest snapshot.

median.description: Continuous median startup time in milliseconds, or null without samples.

p95.description: Continuous 95th percentile startup time in milliseconds, or null without samples.

startup_time_ms.description: Time from attempt to first playing, measured once per eligible view. This is not first-frame timing.

sample_views.description: Views with playing and rebuffer durations available and positive combined duration.

total_playing_time_ms.description: Sum of playing time for eligible buffering samples only.

total_rebuffer_duration_ms.description: Sum of rebuffer time for the same samples.

ratio.description: Total rebuffer time divided by combined playing and rebuffer time. Null without samples. Multiply by 100 for percent.

buffering.description: Duration-weighted buffering. Startup wait, pauses and seeking are excluded by the SDK. Unknown durations are not treated as zero.

affected_views.description: Distinct selected views with at least one observed matching fatal playback_error, including before playback starts.

ratio.description: Affected views divided by all selected attempts; null when views is zero. Multiply by 100 for percent.

fatal_errors.description: Observed fatal errors. Lost events can undercount this metric; absence of an error is not proof of successful playback.

Quality.description: Playback quality for the same start cohort as summary. All rates are fractions. Counts expose measurement coverage.
